title: Verify fee/discount history stays visible when the fee/discount screens are hidden by the feature being off
custom_preconds:
1. A WO already has fee/discount history entries.
  2. The Fees & Discounts feature is then turned OFF for the org.
custom_steps:
1. Turn the Fees & Discounts feature off.
  2. Open the 'Work Order Log' and look for the fee/discount entries recorded earlier.
custom_expected:
1. All fee/discount controls are hidden.
  2. The fee/discount history entries still show in the Work Order Log.
